author_association: Independent saved-image checker reuses the previous batch byte reader and wire decoder. It imports no product module.

full_image_source_pixel_review.method: paired world-space Moller-Trumbore rays against each claimed original source triangle
full_image_source_pixel_review.nearest_surface_scope: separate fixed-grid and visible-selected-triangle representative rays

occluder_diagnosis.centroid_visibility_scope: one fixed interior centroid per selected source triangle

closed_AABB_containment_proofs.proof: Every selected triangle is a convex combination of strictly interior AABB vertices. The complete closed box lies at positive camera depth inside the clipping interval. Each orthographic ray reaching an interior point must first cross an included box surface.

sampled_nearest_scene_review.method: chunked independent Moller-Trumbore rays against every captured triangle

nearest_ray_policy.additional_diagnosis: one centroid per selected source triangle
nearest_ray_policy.representative: first row-major visible pixel per selected triangle
